dialogue.text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. I see you're dealing with some intense itching and red bumps; can you tell me exactly when these symptoms first appeared and if they seem to get worse at night?

The itching and those red bumps started just a few days ago right after I got back from my business trip to Miami. It definitely feels much worse at night; it's so intense that I can't stop scratching myself.

Could you describe the appearance of these bumps, and have you noticed any thin, wavy lines or tracks on your skin near the itchy areas? Also, are the bumps located in specific areas like between your fingers, on your wrists, or around your waistline?

The bumps are small and red, and I have noticed some of those strange wavy lines near my right thigh and forearm. Most of the itching is on my thighs and leg, though I haven't seen much between my fingers or on my wrists yet. It's just so itchy that I've actually scratched my skin raw in a few spots.

That sounds very uncomfortable, and I'm sorry you're dealing with that. During your trip to Miami, were you spending time on the beach or walking barefoot in the sand?
